en.t: The first synod of pope Urban II starts in Melfi, with seventy bishops and twelve abbots in attendance. The synod issues several decrees about church law and deals with the relation with the Greek part of the Church
en.s: The synod of Melfi was an ecclesiastical synod held in Melfi from 10 to 15 September 1089, convened by pope Urban II. Seventy bishops and twelve abbots attended and the synod dealt with various ecclesiastic topics connected to the reform movement as well the relation with the Greek part of the church.

zh.t: 梅尔菲第一次宗教会议
zh.s: 1089年9月10日至15日，教皇乌尔班二世在梅尔菲召开宗教会议，70名主教和12名修道院院长出席。会议讨论了多项教会事务，包括教会改革运动及其与希腊教会的关系。

zh.s: 1197年，阿尤布王朝军队与十字军在雅法城外交战。十字军战败，最终失去了雅法。

en.s: The Battle of Connor was fought on 10 September 1315, in the townland of Tannybrake just over a mile north of what is now the modern village of Connor, County Antrim. It was part of the Bruce campaign in Ireland.

zh.s: 1315年9月10日，康纳战役在安特里姆郡坦尼布雷克镇区爆发，地点位于今康纳村以北略多于1英里处。这是布鲁斯家族爱尔兰战役的一部分。

en.s: John the Fearless, Duke of Burgundy, was assassinated on the bridge at Montereau on 10 September 1419 during a parley with the French Dauphin (the future Charles VII of France), by Tanneguy III du Chastel and Jean Louvet, the Dauphin's close counsellors.

zh.s: 1419年9月10日，勃艮第公爵无畏者约翰在蒙特罗桥上与法国王太子（后来的查理七世）会谈时遭到暗杀。行刺者是太子亲信坦内吉·杜·沙泰尔三世和让·卢韦。

en.s: John I, called the Fearless (French: Jean sans Peur ; Dutch: Jan zonder Vrees; 28 May 1371 – 10 September 1419), was a scion of the French royal family who ruled the Burgundian State as the Duke of Burgundy from 1404 until his assassination in 1419. He played a key role in French national affairs during the early 15th century, particularly in his struggle to remove the mentally ill King Charles VI and during the Hundred Years' War against the Kingdom of England.

zh.s: 无畏者约翰一世（法语：Jean sans Peur；荷兰语：Jan zonder Vrees；1371年5月28日—1419年9月10日）是法国王室后裔，自1404年起以勃艮第公爵身份统治勃艮第公国，直至1419年遭暗杀。15世纪初，他在法国政局中发挥关键作用，尤其积极谋求罢黜患有精神疾病的查理六世，并参与对英格兰王国的百年战争。

en.s: The Battle of Piperdean was an engagement in the Scottish Borders, fought on 10 September 1435 between the Kingdom of Scotland and the Kingdom of England. An English force led by George de Dunbar, 11th Earl of March and Henry Percy, 2nd Earl of Northumberland attempted to take the forfeited Dunbar's Castle of Dunbar back from William Douglas, 2nd Earl of Angus, who as Warden of the Scottish Marches had invested the castle the previous summer.

zh.s: 1435年9月10日，皮珀迪恩战役在苏格兰边境地区爆发，交战双方是苏格兰王国和英格兰王国。乔治·邓巴（马奇伯爵十一世）和诺森伯兰伯爵亨利·珀西二世率领的英军试图从安格斯伯爵威廉·道格拉斯手中夺回邓巴城堡。前一年夏天，身为苏格兰边境守护者的道格拉斯已经围困了这座城堡。

en.t: An earthquake known as "The Lesser Judgment Day" hits Constantinople
en.s: The 1509 Constantinople earthquake, or historically Kıyamet-i Suğra ('Minor Judgment Day'), occurred in the Sea of Marmara on 10 September 1509 at about 22:00. The earthquake had an estimated magnitude of 7.2 ± 0.3 on the surface-wave magnitude scale. A tsunami and 45 days of aftershocks followed the earthquake. The exact death toll of this earthquake is unknown; estimates range between 1,000 and 13,000.

zh.t: 君士坦丁堡大地震（小末日）
zh.s: 1509年9月10日约22时，马尔马拉海发生强烈地震，历史上称为“小末日”（土耳其语：Kıyamet-i Suğra）。地震震级估计为7.2±0.3级（面波震级）。随后发生海啸，并持续出现45天余震。确切死亡人数不明，估计在1000至13000人之间。

en.s: The Battle of Pinkie, also known as the Battle of Pinkie Cleugh (), took place on 10 September 1547 on the banks of the River Esk near Musselburgh, Scotland. The last pitched battle between Scotland and England before the Union of the Crowns, it was part of the conflict known as the Rough Wooing. It was a catastrophic defeat for Scotland, where it became known as "Black Saturday".

zh.s: 平基战役又称平基克卢战役，于1547年9月10日在苏格兰马瑟尔堡附近的埃斯克河畔爆发。这是英格兰和苏格兰在王室合并前最后一场大规模会战，也是粗暴求爱战争的一部分。苏格兰遭遇惨败，此役后来被称为“黑色星期六”。

en.s: The Battle of Obreška (Croatian: Bitka kod Obreške) was fought on 10 September 1565 between the Ottoman forces of Mustafa Pasha Sokolović, sanjakbey of Bosnia, and the Germanic and Croatian forces led by Croatian ban Petar Erdody. The battle was a part of the Croatian–Ottoman wars and Ottoman–Habsburg wars between the Ottoman Empire and the Habsburg monarchy.

zh.s: 1565年9月10日，奥布雷什卡战役爆发，交战双方是奥斯曼军队与德意志、克罗地亚联军。奥斯曼军队由波斯尼亚桑贾克贝伊穆斯塔法·帕夏·索科洛维奇指挥，联军由克罗地亚总督彼得·埃尔德迪率领。这场战役是克罗地亚-奥斯曼战争和奥斯曼-哈布斯堡战争的一部分。

en.t: Christian IV's naval expedition to Stockholm
en.s: The Naval Expedition to Stockholm (Swedish: Sjötåget mot Stockholm; Danish: Kristian IV's Tog mod Stockholm) occurred from 31 August to 10 September 1612, during the late stages of the 1611–1613 Kalmar War. A Danish fleet of 36 warships under Christian IV attempted to capture Stockholm, the de facto capital of the Swedish Empire but failed.

zh.t: 克里斯蒂安四世远征斯德哥尔摩
zh.s: 1612年8月31日至9月10日，卡尔马战争后期，克里斯蒂安四世率领36艘战舰组成的丹麦舰队远征斯德哥尔摩，试图攻占这座瑞典帝国的实际首都，但未能成功。

en.s: The siege of Kreuznach or the Spanish capture of Kreuznach took place on 10 September 1620, at Kreuznach (renamed Bad Kreuznach in 1924) in the Palatinate, where the Army of Flanders, led by the Spanish Don Ambrosio Spinola, defeated the troops of Frederick V, Elector of the Palatinate, during the Palatinate campaign of the Thirty Years' War.

zh.s: 1620年9月10日，西班牙军队攻占普法尔茨的克罗伊茨纳赫（1924年更名为巴特克罗伊茨纳赫）。这是三十年战争期间普法尔茨战役的一部分。西班牙属尼德兰军队由安布罗西奥·斯皮诺拉率领，击败了普法尔茨选帝侯腓特烈五世的部队。

en.t: Fifty-five Christians are executed in Nagasaki during the Great Genna Martyrdom
en.s: The Great Genna Martyrdom (元和の大殉教, Genna no daijunkyō), also known as the Great Martyrdom of Nagasaki, was the execution of 55 foreign and domestic Catholics killed together at Nishizaka Hill in Nagasaki, Japan, on 10 September 1622. Beginning in 1614, Christianity was banned in Japan and a smuggling incident concerning two foreign missionaries prompted the killing.

zh.t: 元和大殉教：长崎处决55名基督徒
zh.s: 1622年9月10日，日本长崎西坂山处决了55名外国和日本本地天主教徒，史称“元和大殉教”，也称长崎大殉教。日本自1614年起禁止基督教；此次处决与两名外国传教士走私入境事件有关。

en.s: The siege of La Rochelle (French: le siège de La Rochelle, or sometimes le grand siège de La Rochelle) was a result of a war between the French royal forces of King Louis XIII and the Huguenots of La Rochelle in 1627–1628. The siege marked the height of the struggle between the Catholics and the Protestants in France and French territories, and ended with a complete victory for Louis XIII and the Catholics.

zh.s: 1627至1628年，法国国王路易十三的王室军队与拉罗谢尔的胡格诺派之间爆发战争，拉罗谢尔围城战由此开始。这场围城战是法国及其领土上天主教徒与新教徒冲突的高潮，最终以路易十三和天主教徒一方全面获胜告终。

en.s: The second siege of Bristol of the First English Civil War lasted from 23 August 1645 until 10 September 1645, when the Royalist commander Prince Rupert surrendered the city that he had captured from the Parliamentarians on 26 July 1643. The commander of the Parliamentarian New Model Army forces besieging Bristol was Lord Fairfax.

zh.s: 第一次英国内战期间，布里斯托第二次围城战从1645年8月23日持续到9月10日。9月10日，王党指挥官鲁珀特亲王投降，议会军夺回了这座城市；他此前于1643年7月26日从议会军手中攻占了布里斯托。围攻布里斯托的新模范军由费尔法克斯勋爵指挥。

en.s: The Tuscarora War was fought in North Carolina from September 10, 1711, until February 11, 1715, between the Tuscarora people and their allies on one side and European American settlers, the Yamasee, and other allies on the other. This was considered the bloodiest colonial war in North Carolina. The Tuscarora signed a treaty with colonial officials in 1718 and settled on a reserved tract of land in Bertie County, North Carolina.

zh.s: 塔斯卡洛拉战争于1711年9月10日至1715年2月11日在北卡罗来纳爆发。塔斯卡洛拉人及其盟友一方与欧洲裔美国殖民者、亚马西人及其他盟友交战。这场战争被认为是北卡罗来纳最血腥的殖民战争。1718年，塔斯卡洛拉人与殖民地官员签订条约，随后迁居到北卡罗来纳州伯蒂县的一块保留地。

en.s: In the Great Northern War (1700–1721) a coalition led by Russia successfully contested the supremacy of Sweden in Northern, Central and Eastern Europe. The initial leaders of the anti-Swedish alliance were Peter I of Russia, Frederick IV of Denmark–Norway and Augustus II the Strong of Saxony-Poland-Lithuania.

zh.s: 大北方战争（1700—1721年）中，以俄罗斯为首的联盟成功挑战了瑞典在北欧、中欧和东欧的霸权。反瑞联盟最初的领导者包括俄罗斯沙皇彼得一世、丹麦-挪威国王腓特烈四世，以及萨克森-波兰-立陶宛的奥古斯特二世。

en.t: Johann Sebastian Bach led the first performance of Jesu, der du meine Seele, BWV 78, a chorale cantata based on a passion hymn by Johann Rist
en.s: Jesu, der du meine Seele (Jesus, you who [rescued] my soul), BWV 78, is a church cantata by Johann Sebastian Bach. He composed it in Leipzig for the 14th Sunday after Trinity and first performed it on 10 September 1724. It is based on the 1641 hymn by Johann Rist, "Jesu, der du meine Seele", for which it is named.

zh.t: 巴赫首演康塔塔《耶稣，你曾救我灵魂》
zh.s: 《耶稣，你曾救我灵魂》（BWV 78）是约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫创作的一部教会康塔塔。他在莱比锡为三一主日后的第14个主日创作此曲，并于1724年9月10日首次演出。作品取材于约翰·里斯特1641年的同名圣诗。

en.s: The Battle of Pondicherry was a naval battle between a British squadron under Vice-Admiral George Pocock and French squadron under Comte d'Aché on 10 September 1759 off the Carnatic coast of India near Pondicherry during the Seven Years' War. Pocock attempted to intercept d'Aché, whose squadron was carrying reinforcements and money for the French forces in Pondicherry.

zh.s: 1759年9月10日，七年战争期间，英国舰队与法国舰队在印度科罗曼德尔海岸、本地治里附近交战。英国舰队由乔治·波考克海军中将指挥，法军由达谢伯爵指挥。波考克试图拦截达谢的舰队；这支法军舰队正为驻扎在本地治里的法军运送增援和资金。

en.s: The Battle of Frisches Haff or Battle of Stettiner Haff was a naval battle between Sweden and Prussia that took place 10 September 1759 as part of the ongoing Seven Years' War. The battle took place in the Szczecin Lagoon (German: Stettiner Haff) between Neuwarp and Usedom, and is named after an ambiguous earlier name for the Lagoon, Frisches Haff, which later exclusively denoted the Vistula Lagoon.

zh.s: 1759年9月10日，七年战争期间，瑞典与普鲁士在什切青潟湖爆发海战。战场位于新瓦尔普和乌泽多姆岛之间。这片潟湖曾有一个含义不明的旧称“弗里舍斯哈夫”，后来这个名称专指维斯瓦潟湖。

en.s: The Battle of Lake Pontchartrain was a single-ship action on September 10, 1779, part of the Anglo-Spanish War. It was fought between the British sloop-of-war HMS West Florida and the Continental Navy schooner USS Morris in the waters of Lake Pontchartrain, then in the British province of West Florida. The West Florida was patrolling on Lake Pontchartrain when it encountered the Morris, which had set out from New Orleans with a Spanish and American crew headed by Continental Navy Captain William Pickles. The larger crew of the Morris successfully boarded the West Florida, inflicting a mortal wound on its captain, Lieutenant John Payne.

zh.s: 1779年9月10日，庞恰特雷恩湖海战爆发。这是英西战争期间的一场单舰交战，交战双方是英国皇家海军单桅战船“西佛罗里达”号和大陆海军纵帆船“莫里斯”号。战斗发生在当时属于英国西佛罗里达省的庞恰特雷恩湖水域。“西佛罗里达”号在湖上巡逻时遇到了“莫里斯”号；后者从新奥尔良出发，由大陆海军上尉威廉·皮克尔斯率领一支西班牙和美国船员组成的船队。人数更多的“莫里斯”号船员成功登上“西佛罗里达”号，并使该舰舰长约翰·佩恩中尉受了致命伤。

en.s: The Battle of Pollilur, also known as the Battle of Polilore or Battle of Perambakam, took place on 10 September 1780 at Pollilur near the city of Kanchipuram in present-day Tamil Nadu state, India as part of the Second Anglo-Mysore War. It was waged between two forces commanded by Tipu Sultan of the Kingdom of Mysore, and Colonel William Baille of the British East India Company. The army of the East India Company surrendered and suffered a high number of casualties. It was the worst loss the British suffered on the subcontinent until Chillianwala. Tipu prevented Col.

zh.s: 波利卢尔战役（又称波利洛尔战役或佩兰巴卡姆战役）于1780年9月10日在印度今泰米尔纳德邦坎奇普兰市附近的波利卢尔爆发，属于第二次英迈索尔战争。迈索尔王国蒂普苏丹率领的部队与英国东印度公司威廉·贝利上校率领的部队交战。东印度公司军队投降并遭受重大伤亡。这是英国在印度次大陆遭遇的最惨重失败，直到奇利安瓦拉战役才被超越。

en.s: The action of 10 September 1782 was a minor engagement between five merchant vessels — four East Indiamen of the British East India Company and a country-ship — on the one side, and a French frigate on the other. The action resulted in only a few casualties and was inconclusive.

zh.s: 1782年9月10日，英国东印度公司4艘东印度商船和一艘本地商船组成的船队，与一艘法国护卫舰发生小规模交战。双方伤亡不多，战斗没有明确结果。

en.s: The Battle of St. George's Caye was a military engagement that lasted from 3 to 10 September 1798, off the coast of British Honduras (present-day Belize). However, the name is typically reserved for the final battle that occurred on 10 September in which the Spanish were defeated. The events of 10 September 1798 marked the final Spanish attempt to take over the area.
en.n: At the Battle of St. George's Caye, British Honduras defeats Spain.

zh.s: 圣乔治礁战役于1798年9月3日至10日在英属洪都拉斯（今伯利兹）海岸外进行。通常所说的圣乔治礁战役特指9月10日的最后一场交战，西班牙军队在此战败。1798年9月10日的战斗标志着西班牙最后一次试图夺取该地区。
zh.n: 圣乔治礁战役中，英属洪都拉斯击败西班牙。

en.s: The Battle of Krabbendam (also called the Battle of Zijpedijk) of 10 September 1799 was fought during the Anglo-Russian Invasion of Holland between forces of the French Republic and her ally, the Batavian Republic, under the command of French general Guillaume Marie Anne Brune on one side, and a British division under general Sir Ralph Abercromby on the other. The British division had established a bridgehead in the extreme north of the North-Holland peninsula after the Battle of Callantsoog (1799). Brune tried to dislodge them before they could be reinforced by further Anglo-Russian forces, but the British prevailed.

zh.s: 克拉贝丹姆战役（也称齐佩代克战役）于1799年9月10日爆发，是英俄入侵荷兰期间的一场战斗。法兰西共和国及其盟友巴达维亚共和国一方由法国将军纪尧姆·马里·安·布吕纳指挥，另一方则是拉尔夫·阿伯克龙比将军率领的英国师。卡洛佐海战之后，英军师已在北荷兰半岛最北端建立桥头堡。布吕纳试图在更多英俄援军赶到前将其击退，但英军最终取胜。

en.s: The Second Battle of Tripoli Harbor was a naval action that occurred during the American naval blockade, which took place in Tripoli Harbor between August and September 1804. The battle was part of the First Barbary War between forces of the United States and the forces of the Eyalet of Tripolitania.

zh.s: 1804年8月至9月，美国海军封锁的黎波里港期间，双方在港内发生第二次海战。这是第一次巴巴里战争中美国与的黎波里塔尼亚行省之间的海上交战。

en.s: The Battle of Lake Erie, also known as the Battle of Put-in-Bay, was fought on 10 September 1813, on Lake Erie off the shores of Ohio during the War of 1812. Nine vessels of the United States Navy defeated and captured six vessels of the British Royal Navy.

zh.s: 伊利湖战役又称普特因湾战役，于1813年9月10日在1812年战争期间爆发，战场位于俄亥俄州沿岸的伊利湖水域。美国海军9艘舰船击败并俘获了英国皇家海军的6艘舰船。

en.s: The 1821 Maine gubernatorial election took place on September 10, 1821 to elect the Governor of Maine. Democratic-Republican candidate Albion Parris defeated Federalist candidate Ezekiel Whitman and Democratic-Republican Joshua Wingate, Jr.

en.s: 55 Pandora is a fairly large and relatively bright asteroid in the asteroid belt. Pandora was discovered by American astronomer and Catholic priest George Mary Searle on 10 September 1858, from the Dudley Observatory near Albany, New York. It was his only asteroid discovery. en.s: The Battle of Carnifex Ferry took place on September 10, 1861 in Nicholas County, Virginia (now West Virginia), as part of the Operations in Western Virginia Campaign during the American Civil War. The battle resulted in a Union strategic victory that contributed to the eventual Confederate withdrawal from western Virginia. The campaign helped pave the way for the subsequent creation of the separate state of West Virginia. The battle took its name from a former settlement, which was named after the local Carnefix family.

en.s: The Battle of Stockton-on-Tees, often referred to as the Battle of Stockton, took place on 10 September 1933 at Market Cross in the High Street of Stockton-on-Tees, County Durham, England. It was clash between members of the British Union of Fascists and anti-fascist demonstrators, including local communists and supporters of the Labour Party. The march was an early attempt by the BUF to rally support in depressed areas, but the anti-fascists protested and drove out the BUF supporters who had been shipped in from other areas.

zh.s: 1933年9月10日，英格兰达勒姆郡斯托克顿的主街十字路口发生冲突，交战双方是英国法西斯联盟成员和反法西斯示威者。示威者中包括当地共产党人和工党支持者。这次游行是英国法西斯联盟试图在经济萧条地区争取支持的早期行动之一，但反法西斯人士举行抗议，并赶走了从外地乘车前来的法西斯联盟支持者。

en.s: The World Championship of Speedway is an international competition between the highest-ranked motorcycle speedway riders of the world, run under the auspices of the Fédération Internationale de Motocyclisme (FIM). The first official championships were held in 1936. Today, the championship is organised as a series of Speedway Grand Prix events, where points are awarded according to performance in the event and tallied up at the end of each season.

en.s: Battle of Łomża (7–10 September 1939) was a series of armed engagements during the Nazi German and Soviet Invasion of Poland. The battle took place in and around the town of Łomża, on both sides of the Narew River. Polish forces successfully held a series of pre-First World War forts from repeated German attack before being forced to withdraw due to the position becoming untenable following their losses at the Battle of Wizna and Battle of Nowogród.

en.s: The Battle of Haeju was a small naval battle during the main phase of Korean War. Off Haeju Bay in the Yellow Sea, on September 10, 1950, days before the Battle of Inchon, a South Korean navy patrol boat, PC-703, encountered a North Korean navy minelayer sailing vessel. After a brief fight, the North Korean minelayer was sunk with a loss of all crew and no South Korean casualties were reported. After the minelayer's sinking, PC-703 discovered that the sunken vessel had laid a mine field at the mouth of the Haeju Man and then reported to base the location of the sea mines.

zh.s: 1950年9月10日，仁川登陆战前几天，朝鲜战争进入主要阶段期间，韩国海军巡逻艇PC-703在黄海海州湾外遇到一艘朝鲜海军布雷帆船，双方爆发小规模海战。短暂交火后，朝鲜布雷船沉没，船员全部遇难；韩国方面没有报告人员伤亡。随后，PC-703发现沉船曾在海州湾口布设水雷，并将雷区位置报告给基地。

en.s: The 1961 Italian Grand Prix was a Formula One motor race held on 10 September 1961 at Monza. The race was marked by one of the most terrible accidents in the history of Formula One, when on the end of lap 2 at the approach to the Parabolica the German driver Wolfgang von Trips lost control of his Ferrari and crashed into a stand full of spectators, killing 15 and himself. The race was not stopped, allegedly to assist the rescue work for the injured.

The election was held on 10 September 2000 and all 6 seats in New Territories West, which consists of Tsuen Wan District, Tuen Mun District, Yuen Long District, Kwai Tsing District and Islands District, were contested. The Democratic Party first applied electoral strategy of dividing three candidate lists in order to avoid wasted votes, as largest remainder method encouraged.

zh.t: 2000年香港立法会选举新界西选区结果
zh.s: 这是2000年香港立法会选举的新界西选区结果。选举于2000年9月10日举行，新界西的6个席位全部改选，选区包括荃湾区、屯门区、元朗区、葵青区和离岛区。民主党首次把候选人分成3张名单参选，以避免选票浪费；最大余数法为这种做法提供了动力。

en.t: 2000 Hong Kong legislative election in Kowloon East
en.s: These are the Kowloon East results of the 2000 Hong Kong legislative election. The election was held on 10 September 2000 and all 4 seats in Kowloon East which consisted of Wong Tai Sin District and Kwun Tong District were contested. The Democratic Alliance for the Betterment of Hong Kong received more votes than the Democratic Party for the first time, with Chan Kam-lam getting elected.

zh.t: 2000年香港立法会选举九龙东选区结果
zh.s: 这是2000年香港立法会选举的九龙东选区结果。选举于2000年9月10日举行，九龙东4个席位全部改选，选区包括黄大仙区和观塘区。民主建港联盟的得票首次超过民主党，陈鉴林当选。

en.s: The 2000 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final was the culmination of the 2000 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship. It was played on 10 September 2000 between Kilkenny and Offaly. Kilkenny was appearing in their third consecutive All-Ireland final after losing to Offaly in 1998 and to Cork in 1999. They aimed to win their first championship since 1993. In their first championship game since winning the championship in 1998, Offaly lined up.

zh.s: 这场决赛是2000年全爱尔兰高级板棍球锦标赛的收官之战，于2000年9月10日由基尔肯尼对阵奥法利。基尔肯尼连续第三年进入全爱尔兰决赛，此前分别在1998年输给奥法利、1999年输给科克；球队希望赢得自1993年以来的首个冠军。奥法利则是在1998年夺冠后首次参加锦标赛比赛。

en.s: As part of the 2000 Hong Kong legislative election, held 10 September, all 5 seats in Hong Kong Island were contested. en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Norway on 9 and 10 September 2001. The governing Labour Party lost seats and their vote share was the lowest they had ever obtained in a post-war election. Although they still won a plurality of votes and seats, they were unable to form a government. Instead, a centre-right coalition of the Conservative Party, the Christian People's Party and Liberal Party was formed, led by Prime Minister Kjell Magne Bondevik of the Christian Democratic Party, with confidence and supply support from the Progress Party.

zh.s: 2001年9月9日至10日，挪威举行议会选举。执政工党失去席位，得票率也降至战后选举中的最低水平。尽管工党仍获得最多选票和席位，却无法组建政府。最终，保守党、基督教人民党和自由党组成中右翼联合政府，由基督教人民党籍首相谢尔·马涅·邦德维克领导；进步党则为政府提供信任与供给支持。

en.t: Antônio da Costa Santos, mayor of Campinas, Brazil is assassinated
en.s: Antônio da Costa Santos (also known as Toninho; 4 March 1952 – 10 September 2001) was a Brazilian architect and politician of the Workers' Party (PT). Toninho took office as Mayor of Campinas (the third largest city in the state of São Paulo, with over 1,000,000 inhabitants), on 1 January 2001. He was shot to death at 10:15 pm, 10 September 2001, as he was driving home alone from a shopping mall.

zh.t: 坎皮纳斯市长安东尼奥·达科斯塔·桑托斯遇刺身亡
zh.s: 安东尼奥·达科斯塔·桑托斯（又称托尼尼奥，1952年3月4日－2001年9月10日）是巴西建筑师、劳工党（PT）政治人物。坎皮纳斯是圣保罗州第三大城市，人口超过100万。桑托斯于2001年1月1日就任市长。9月10日晚上10时15分，他独自驾车从购物中心回家途中遭枪击身亡。

en.s: The 2002 Orange County, Florida, Chairman election took place on September 10, 2002. en.s: The Battle of the Palm Grove (10-13 September 2010) took place during the Iraq War when elements of the Second Advise and Assist Brigade (Stryker Brigade Combat Team), 25th ID of the US Army and 512th Military Police Company US Army supported 200 Iraqi Army and Iraqi Police in a search and sweep operation against 15-25 insurgents planting IEDs in Hudaidy, Diyala Province. During the fighting, Apache attack helicopters and Air Force F-16 fighters were called in. The fighter jets dropped two 500-lb. bombs, but to little effect.
en.n: The U.S. Army Center of Military History’s battle map dates the Palm Grove operation to September 10–13, 2010. This entry follows the start shown on that map.

zh.s: 棕榈林战役发生于2010年9月10日至13日，是伊拉克战争期间的一场战斗。美国陆军第25步兵师史崔克旅战斗队的第二顾问与协助旅，以及第512宪兵连，支援约200名伊拉克陆军和警察人员，在迪亚拉省胡代迪搜查并清剿15至25名正在埋设简易爆炸装置的叛乱分子。战斗期间，美军出动阿帕奇攻击直升机和空军F-16战斗机。战斗机投下两枚500磅炸弹，但效果有限。
zh.n: 美国陆军军事史中心的战役地图将棕榈林行动标为2010年9月10日至13日。本条按该地图所示的开始日期列出。

en.s: An election for the leadership of the Alberta Liberal Party was held on September 10, 2011, which was caused by David Swann's announcement on February 1, 2011, of his intention to resign as leader. The election is the party's second since the 2008 election. MLA Raj Sherman was elected on the first ballot. An open nomination system was used in which any Albertan could vote in the election, even if they were not party members.

zh.t: 2011年艾伯塔省自由党党魁选举
zh.s: 2011年9月10日，艾伯塔省自由党举行党魁选举。此前，大卫·斯旺于2011年2月1日宣布打算辞去党魁职务。该党上一次党魁选举是在2008年。省议员拉吉·谢尔曼在首轮投票中当选。此次选举采用开放提名制度，任何艾伯塔省居民都能投票，无须是党员。

en.s: Indirect presidential elections were held in Somalia on 10 September 2012. The newly appointed Federal Parliament elected Hassan Sheikh Mohamud as the first President of Somalia since the dissolution of the Transitional Federal Government (TFG). The election had previously been scheduled for 20 August, the same day that the mandate of the TFG expired, but was rescheduled for a later date.

en.s: The Colorado recall election of 2013 was a successful effort to recall two Democratic members of the Colorado Senate following their support of new gun control legislation. Initially four politicians were targeted, but sufficient signatures could only be obtained for State Senate President John Morse and State Senator Angela Giron. During the petition drive, national organizations on both the gun rights and gun control sides became involved by providing mailings and donations. Once the petitions were submitted, Morse and Giron challenged the effort in court, but were denied the injunction that they had requested from the court.

zh.s: 2013年科罗拉多州罢免选举旨在罢免两名民主党籍州参议员，此前他们支持了新的枪支管制法案。最初有4名政界人士面临罢免，但只有州参议院议长约翰·莫尔斯和州参议员安吉拉·希龙获得了足够的签名。在征集签名期间，支持和反对枪支权利的全国性组织都介入其中，提供宣传材料和捐款。请愿书提交后，莫尔斯和希龙向法院申请阻止罢免，但法院驳回了他们的申请。

en.t: Polaris Dawn, the first private crewed spaceflight to involve a spacewalk, is launched from the Kennedy Space Center in Florida
en.s: Polaris Dawn was a private crewed spaceflight operated by SpaceX on behalf of Shift4 CEO Jared Isaacman, the first of three planned missions in the Polaris program. Launched September 10, 2024, as the 14th crewed orbital flight of a Crew Dragon spacecraft, Isaacman and his crew of three — Scott Poteet, Sarah Gillis and Anna Menon — flew in an elliptic orbit that took them 1,400 kilometers (870 mi; 760 nmi) away from Earth, the farthest crewed non-lunar mission and the farthest any human has been without leaving low Earth orbit.

zh.s: 北极星黎明号是SpaceX代表Shift4首席执行官贾里德·艾萨克曼执行的私人载人航天任务，也是北极星计划中三项计划任务的首项。2024年9月10日，搭载艾萨克曼和3名乘组成员斯科特·波蒂特、莎拉·吉利斯、安娜·梅农的龙飞船发射升空，成为第14次载人龙飞船轨道飞行。飞船进入椭圆轨道，最远飞到距地球1400公里（870英里；760海里）处，创造了载人非月球任务的最远飞行纪录，也是人类在未离开近地轨道情况下到达的最远距离。

en.s: On September 10, 2025, Charlie Kirk, an American right-wing political activist, was assassinated at Utah Valley University in Orem, Utah, while speaking at an outdoor campus debate planned by Turning Point USA, the conservative youth organization he co-founded and led. Kirk had been a close ally of US president Donald Trump and a highly influential figure in the MAGA movement.

zh.s: 2025年9月10日，美国右翼政治活动人士查理·柯克在犹他州奥勒姆的犹他谷大学遇刺身亡。当时，他正在参加一场户外校园辩论活动，活动由他共同创立并领导的保守派青年组织“美国转折点”策划。柯克是美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的亲密盟友，也是“MAGA”运动中影响力很大的人物。
